executiveSummary.title: CueFinder E2E Test Report - Complete Analysis

criticalIssues.title: Test Users Don't Exist in Database
criticalIssues.rootCause: Tests use credentials 'testuser' / 'TestPassword123!' which don't exist in the database
criticalIssues.symptom: Login endpoint returns 'Invalid username or password'
criticalIssues.fix: Create a Playwright global setup file that registers test users before test execution

criticalIssues.title: localStorage Access Denied (Cross-Origin)
criticalIssues.rootCause: Browser security policy prevents reading localStorage in certain contexts
criticalIssues.symptom: DOMException: Failed to read 'localStorage' property from 'Window': Access is denied
criticalIssues.fix: Fixed - Added try-catch wrapper in getAuthToken() and isLoggedIn() helper functions

highPriorityIssues.title: Modal Visibility Timeout
highPriorityIssues.symptom: Timeout waiting for Sign In / Create Account heading to become visible
highPriorityIssues.rootCause: Modal dialog container appears but content rendering is delayed
highPriorityIssues.fix: Implemented - Increased timeout from 5s to 15-20s for modal visibility waits

highPriorityIssues.title: Forum Sidebar Navigation Not Found
highPriorityIssues.symptom: Timeout waiting for [data-testid='sidebar-forum'] element to be clickable
highPriorityIssues.rootCause: Forum navigation component not rendering or selector mismatch
highPriorityIssues.action: Requires UI inspection - verify forum sidebar renders correctly

fixesApplied.change: Added .first() to ambiguous button selectors to resolve strict mode violations
Changed loginUser() to return token string directly instead of object
Wrapped getAuthToken() and isLoggedIn() in try-catch
Increased modal/form visibility timeouts from 5s to 10-20s
Updated browser context settings for storage state handling

test_user_missing.description: Test users not registered in database

other_timeouts.description: Various other timeout and visibility issues
